$description: Design For Humans - Tier 3 Component Design Tokens (W3C DTCG Standard)

avatar.$description: User profile avatar and avatar group tokens

size.$description: Default avatar diameter (3rem / 48px meets WCAG 2.5.5 target size)

sm-size.$description: Small avatar diameter (2rem / 32px meets WCAG 2.5.8 target size)

square-radius.$description: Corner radius for squircle / square avatars

border-width.$description: Border stroke width for avatar outline

border-color.$description: Border stroke color for avatar outline

font-weight.$description: Font weight for initials and counts

placeholder-border-color.$description: Dashed border color for placeholder avatars

group-overlap.$description: Negative margin for overlapping stacked avatar groups

badge.$description: Count or dot attached to a host element. Colour comes from the Tier 2 intent roles.

size.$description: Minimum block and inline size of a count badge

status.$description: State of a thing: text with an optional dot or icon. Colour comes from the Tier 2 intent roles.

translucency.$description: How far the tint surface fades on the default (outline) prominence

border-block-end-width.$description: Heavier lower edge that reads as a physical key

icon.$description: Inline SVG glyph sized in em, so it follows the text around it.

icon-box.$description: Fixed square frame around an icon, aligned with control sizes.

padding.$description: Padding between the banner edge and its icon, body and actions

body-padding.$description: Inline padding of the banner body; half of it on the block axis

gap.$description: Gap between icon, body and actions, and between lines of the body

translucency.$description: How much of the surface shows through a translucent banner

filter.$description: Backdrop filter of a translucent banner

banner-dock.$description: Placement container that pins a banner to the page edge

z-index.$description: Stacking layer of a sticky or fixed dock

padding-block.$description: Block padding around a floating dock banner

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding around a floating dock banner

batch-actions.$description: The bar shown while items are selected: a summary, actions and a way to clear the selection

docked-bg.$description: Surface of a docked or inline bar

filter.$description: Backdrop filter of the floating bar

gap.$description: Gap between the summary, actions and dismiss button

offset.$description: Distance of the floating bar from the bottom of the viewport

z-index.$description: Stacking layer of a floating or docked bar

color.$description: Tone: text and border at rest, fill on hover

padding-inline.$description: Horizontal inline padding for block link

padding-block.$description: Vertical block padding for block link

radius.$description: Border radius for block link container

transition.$description: Smooth transition duration for surface and color changes

breadcrumb.$description: The trail of ancestors of the current page

gap.$description: Space between an item and its separator

navigation-tree.$description: Nested links to the sections of a site or page. Its items are buttons.

color.$description: Text colour of an item that isn't current

rule-width.$description: Guide line beside a nested list (--ruled)

current-color.$description: Text colour of the current item

rail-width.$description: Minimum width of the current-location rail; the button's radius wins when it is larger

lockup-gap.$description: Gap between paired text inside a button lockup

button-group.$description: A set of related buttons laid out together

compact-gap.$description: Gap between buttons in a compact group

rule-width.$description: Rule between buttons in a ruled group

border-width.$description: Card edge; default, strong and subtle-less prominences

hover-shadow.$description: Shadow on hover for a linked card

padding.$description: Outer padding of the card parts

band-gap.$description: Gap between items in a band

deck.$description: Media and audio playback deck container tokens

art-size.$description: Album or media art thumbnail dimensions

on-air-border.$description: Active broadcast on-air perimeter highlight color

width.$description: Inline size of a modal dialog

lg-box-size.$description: Large checkbox and radio box size

pagination.$description: A button group of page links

Transition speed for hover and active thumb states
